# ci/safety-config/table.tsv
# Checker configurations and time limits of single exports, read by
# ci/jobs/safety.sh. One row per entry, five tab-separated fields:
#   unit      a shell pattern over the unit names (x86_64-avx2, aarch64-*)
#   export    an export of src/nirapod_sha2.jinc
#   config    a JSON file of this directory passed with --config, or -
#   limit     the time limit of the run in seconds, or - for
#             CI_SAFETY_TIMEOUT
#   reason    why the export needs it, with what it was measured on
# The first matching row applies. Every row must match an export of a
# unit, and every configuration file must exist. The options the files
# may set (array_track_max_bytes, congruence_reduction,
# relational_loop_vars) can only add alarms, never remove one, so a
# configuration changes what the checker can prove, never what a PASS
# means. Exports without a row run with the checker's defaults.
# coarse.json  array_track_max_bytes 32 (cells of arrays over 32 bytes are
#              not dimensions of the numerical state), congruence_reduction
#              1 (congruences passed on only for the variables an operation
#              writes)
# unit
aarch64-sha2
column5: the default configuration reaches no verdict within the default limit; this one does, and the verdict names the lane reads
